summary: Full end-to-end validation of the Tickets/Reserve/Phone/Carousel batch. Backend (9/9 pytest) and Frontend (desktop+mobile) all pass. Order phone is now required (422 on missing/short), buyer_phone is persisted, /api/reservations stores messages with topic 'VIP Table Reservation' and phone/guests/floor, /tickets 3-poster carousel + dots + mobile hint working, VIP list has 3 checks + 7 trophy items with exact copy, standard list has 3 checks + 3 red X + upsell note, FAQ EN/CZ content matches spec, Teya payment step still mounts after phone field addition.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: /admin/orders excludes 'created' & 'pending' orders (server.py line ~1106); this is intentional to hide abandoned Teya sessions but means the buyer_phone verification via admin UI is only visible AFTER payment. Verified via direct DB read that buyer_phone is stored on unpaid orders too.
